question: Where is Luminara Med Spa located?
answer: We're located at 1240 Central Park Blvd, Suite 110, Fredericksburg, VA 22401 — in the Central Park area, easy to get to from Stafford and Spotsylvania. Free parking right out front.

question: What are your hours?
answer: We're open Monday through Friday 9am–6pm, and Saturday 9am–4pm. We're closed Sundays. Evening appointments are available on Tuesdays and Thursdays until 7pm.

question: How do I book a consultation?
answer: Consultations are always free and no-pressure. You can book through our website, call us at (540) 899-4200, or let Luna capture your info right here and we'll reach out to schedule you.

question: Do you offer financing?
answer: Yes — we offer CareCredit and Cherry financing with 0% interest plans available. You can apply in minutes. We also offer treatment packages that reduce the per-session cost significantly.

question: What should I do to prepare for my first appointment?
answer: Come with a clean face and no makeup if possible. Avoid alcohol and blood thinners (like aspirin or ibuprofen) for 24-48 hours before injectable treatments. Arrive 15 minutes early to complete your intake paperwork.

question: Do your treatments hurt?
answer: Most clients find our treatments very tolerable. We use topical numbing cream for all injectable and microneedling treatments — you'll feel some pressure or mild stinging, but not sharp pain. Most people are surprised by how comfortable the process is.

question: How long do results last?
answer: It depends on the treatment. Botox lasts 3-4 months, fillers 9-18 months, Sculptra up to 2 years, Morpheus8 results continue improving for 6 months after treatment. We'll walk through realistic expectations at your consultation.

question: Is Botox safe?
answer: Botox has been FDA-approved and used safely for over 30 years — it's one of the most studied cosmetic treatments in the world. All injections at Luminara are performed or supervised by licensed medical professionals.

question: Can I combine multiple treatments in one visit?
answer: Absolutely — many clients combine Botox and filler in the same session for a comprehensive refresh. We can also pair a HydraFacial with other treatments. Your provider will help you design a treatment plan that makes sense for your goals and budget.

question: What's the difference between Botox and fillers?
answer: Botox relaxes the muscles that cause expression lines — forehead, crow's feet, frown lines. Fillers restore volume and smooth folds that are there even when your face is at rest — like nasolabial folds, under-eye hollows, and lips. They work differently and often complement each other.

question: Am I too young for these treatments?
answer: There's no one-size-fits-all age. Many clients start Botox in their late 20s or early 30s as a preventive measure. Fillers are often started in the mid-30s when volume loss begins. The best approach is a consultation — we'll give you an honest recommendation, not a sales pitch.

question: Will I look overdone or unnatural?
answer: Not at Luminara. Our philosophy is 'you, but refreshed.' We prioritize natural-looking results. Overfilled or frozen faces come from poor technique and overtreatment — our providers are trained in subtle, facial-harmony-based aesthetics.

question: Do you treat men?
answer: Absolutely — about 25% of our clients are men. Botox, filler, Kybella for a defined jawline, and laser hair removal are especially popular with male clients. Everything is customized to look natural and masculine.

question: What is your cancellation policy?
answer: We ask for 24-hour notice for cancellations to avoid a $50 cancellation fee. We understand life happens — just give us a call and we'll work with you.

question: Who performs the treatments?
answer: Our treatments are performed by our team of licensed medical professionals: Dr. Sarah Chen (Medical Director), Jennifer Walsh RN (Aesthetic Nurse), and Michelle Torres (Licensed Aesthetician). All injectable treatments are performed by our nurse injector or medical director.

question: Do you offer a loyalty or membership program?
answer: Yes — our Luminara Glow Membership includes a monthly HydraFacial, 15% off all services, and priority booking. Members also get early access to seasonal promotions. Ask about membership at your consultation.

question: What areas do you serve?
answer: We primarily serve clients from Fredericksburg, Stafford, Spotsylvania, King George, and the surrounding Northern Virginia region. We have clients who drive from Woodbridge and Culpeper — people tell us it's worth the trip.

question: Can I get treatments if I'm pregnant or nursing?
answer: We do not perform injectable treatments (Botox, fillers, Kybella) or laser/IPL treatments on clients who are pregnant or nursing. A HydraFacial with approved serums may be an option — we review this individually at consultation.

question: How soon will I see results?
answer: Filler results are immediate. Botox results appear in 3-7 days and peak at 2 weeks. Morpheus8 results build over 3-6 months. HydraFacial results are immediate — your skin glows the same day.

question: Do you have before and after photos?
answer: Yes — we have a gallery on our website and on our Instagram @luminaramedspa. We can also share relevant before and after photos during your consultation so you can see realistic results for your specific concern.
